name: Gameone Holdings Limited
summary: Gameone Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the development, operation, publishing, and distribution of online and mobile games, and online PC games in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company operates through the Game Business, Software Service Business, and Trading Agent Services segments. It engages in the provision of internet security technical and big data related analysis services; trading of virtual games items; software and communication equipment development, distribution, and technical consulting; and sale of supplies. The company also acts as an intermediary between buyers and suppliers. It serves third-party game operators and game developers/operators. Gameone Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
